issues.on_page: p6 (modified cash basis) ending net position 8,570,203; p10 (second proprietary statement) ending 8,757,394; FY2024 report beginning net position 8,859,843 ('beginning of year, restated' on its second statement; Water 1,116,508, Sewer 1,000,575, Sewer Treatment 6,552,942, Garbage 15,631, Golf 174,187)

issues.extracted: per-fund statement lines for General, Bond and Interest, Street, Fire Hall (p4) and the five proprietary funds (p6), plus combining-schedule lines for the other funds (p13)
issues.issue: The 2026-10-28 per-fund rule says statement lines are not added for the other funds when some funds have their own schedules. Here the other governmental funds have a combining schedule. The extractor added statement lines for the major and proprietary funds anyway (FY2024 does the same). Amounts are correct and there is no double counting.
